description: UNAVAILABLE: Selectivity ratios over padj-censored data treat a missing (not significant or not profiled) contrast as 0 and pool doses; a censored comparison verb arrives in phase 3.; use functional_genomics.query_drug_perturbation. Find genes with cell line-selective drug effects.

cell_line_of_interest.description: Accepts depmap_cell_line; resolved to one depmap_cell_line (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

comparison_cell_lines.description: Accepts depmap_cell_line; resolved to one depmap_cell_line (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

concentration.description: Results are per concentration; pass one value, or the call fails with incomplete_key when several apply.

concentration_unit.description: Results are per concentration_unit; pass one value, or the call fails with incomplete_key when several apply.

drug_name.description: Accepts tahoe_drug; resolved to one tahoe_drug (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

plate.description: Results are listed per plate; pass one value to restrict them.
